cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Confess Around Them
cards.instruction: Use partial admissions to make a reciprocal confession feel like the only missing piece.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. I changed the meeting time. Did you change the room?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You changed the time?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Yes. That's my half of why nobody met.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why didn't you tell me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I should have. Now tell me where your half of the meeting went.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved the soup. You may start lunch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was asking whether you'd pass the salt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your request is under consideration.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll get it myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent initiative. Approved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Welcome to my garage sale. Your offer to browse is accepted.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's my garage. You're helping.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And you're doing very well under my supervision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm going inside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Granted. Take five.

cards.title: Be Right in Retrospect

beats.text: I said we'd need to open up. The plumbing listened first.
